blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Voice-cloning TTS models synthesize an unseen speaker's voice from brief speech prompts, but it remains unclear which acoustic properties they represent and use. We introduce a feature-based interpretability framework for autoregressive voice-cloning TTS models, analyzing features from sparse autoencoders (SAEs), PCA, and random directions via sparse probing, steering, and quantitative auto-interpretability. We focus on Qwen3-TTS and extend probing and steering to $5$ additional models to test generalization across architectures. These models encode concepts like pitch, energy, noise, and accent, but sparse prediction and steering are effective only for some concepts. Strong probing does not always translate to steering or vice-versa. SAEs are useful for sparse probing of human-labelled concepts and novel-concept discovery, while PCA is competitive for dense probing and steering. Auto-interpretability finds $684$ automatically validated SAE features in Qwen3-TTS covering speaker clusters, speaking style, and recording conditions beyond known concepts. Overall, we perform a comprehensive interpretability study of autoregressive voice-cloning TTS models.
blocks.zh: 语音克隆 TTS模型从简短的语音提示中合成出一个看不见的扬声器的声音,但是仍然不清楚它们代表并使用的是哪个声学属性. 我们为自递式语音克隆TTS模型引入了基于特性的可解释性框架,通过稀有的自发编码器(SAEs),PCA(PPC)和随机方向分析功能,通过稀有的检测,引导和定量自发可解释. 我们侧重于Qune3-TTS,并将探测和引导扩大到5美元的额外模型,以测试整个建筑的通化. 这些模型编码了投出,能量,噪音,口音等概念,但稀有的预测和指向只对一些概念有效. 强力探测并不总是会变成方向或相反。 SAE对于人类标有标志的概念和新概念的发现的微乎其微的探索很有用,而五氯苯甲醚则对密集的探测和引导具有竞争力。 自动可解释性在Qwen3-TTS中找到684美元自动验证的SAE特性,涵盖演讲者集群,演讲风格,以及记录超出已知概念的条件. 总体而言,我们对自旋式语音克隆TTS模型进行全面可解释性研究.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Zero-shot voice-cloning TTS models ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) synthesize speech in an unseen speaker’s voice from a few seconds of prompt speech. Speech entangles speaker identity, vocal texture, emotion, and pacing. We ask which concepts these models represent, whether they can be predicted from a few features and steered during generation, and what their features capture beyond predefined labels. We study these questions through sparse probing, generation-time steering, and quantitative auto-interpretability for novel concept discovery.
This provides a way to test acoustic controls in TTS models and inspect speech properties beyond predefined labels.
blocks.zh:
零镜头的语音克隆TTS模型(Chen等人,2025年;Du等人,2024年;Hu等人,2026年)从几秒钟的即时语音中合成了无见的语音. 语音缠绕扬声器身份,声调纹理,情感,以及节奏. 我们问这些模型代表哪些概念,它们是否可以从几个特性中预测,并在一代人中被引导,它们的特性捕捉到哪些超越了预先定义的标签. 我们通过很少的探险, 一代时间的引导, 和定量的自动解释来研究这些问题。
这为测试TTS模型中的声控提供了一种方法,并检查超出预定义标签的语音属性.

blocks.en: Our analysis builds on sparse-autoencoder (SAE) work ( Huben et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) that decomposes activations into interpretable feature dictionaries. Earlier speech SAE work ( Aparin et al., 2026 ) studies encoders, while earlier TTS work ( Varshavsky-Hassid et al., 2024 ; Lenglet et al., 2026 ) studies known concepts in non-voice-cloning models. We instead study known and novel concepts in zero-shot voice-cloning models. The closest speech auto-interpretability work, AudioSAE ( Aparin et al., 2026 ) , uses natural-language labels for qualitative inspection; we quantitatively test whether labels are coherent, predictive of held-out audio, and stable under relabeling. While CoCoEmo ( Wang et al., 2026 ) uses supervised steering directions and controllable TTS systems ( Diwan et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2024 ) use explicit style labels, we steer using unsupervised feature dictionaries. While contemporaneous work on CosyVoice3 ( Koriagin et al., 2026 ) also performs SAE probing and steering, we compare feature methods across 6 6 TTS models to test generalization across architectures. Rather than 3 3 select concepts, our steering evaluation covers 55 55 extractor concepts.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析基于稀疏的自动编码器工作(Huben等人,2024年;Gao等人,2025年),将激活分解成可解释的特征词典。 早期的语音SAE工作(Aparin等人,2026年)研究编码器,而早期的TTS工作(Varshavsky-Hassid等人,2024年;Lenglet等人,2026年)研究非语音克隆模型中已知的概念. 相反,我们在零镜头语音克隆模型中研究已知和新颖的概念。 最近的语音自动解译工作AudioSAE(Aparin et al., 2026)使用自然语言的标签进行质检;我们在量学上检验标签是否一致,预言被扣留的音频,并在重新标签下保持稳定. CoCoEmo(Wang等人,2026年)使用有监督的指导方向和可控制的TTS系统(Diwan等人,2025年;Du等人,2024年)使用明显的样式标签,而我们使用无监督的特征词典进行引导. 同时期关于CosyVoice3(Koriagin等人,2026年)的工作也进行SAE检测和引导,但我们比较了6个TTS模型的特征方法,以测试跨架构的通用性. 我们的指导性评价包括55个55个提炼概念,而不是3个选定的概念。

blocks.zh: 图 1:我们的主要可解释性评价程序。 我们通过已知概念的验证和引导,通过6个语音克隆TTS模型,并通过Qune3-TTS中的定量自动解释来评估特征集,以发现新概念.

blocks.en: We study Qwen3-TTS ( Hu et al., 2026 ) as our primary model, and extend probing and steering to 5 5 additional Fish, Higgs, and CosyVoice2 models to test generalization across architectures. We convert activations into utterance-level features using SAE, PCA, random directions, and untrained SAEs. We find that models encode pitch, energy, noise, accent, and emotion, but only some concepts are predictable from a few features. PCA and random directions are strong baselines, while SAEs outperform PCA on average in sparse prediction of human-labelled concepts. Feature directions can steer pitch, energy, noise, and spectral properties, with effects varying by model and concept. Strong sparse prediction does not always translate to steering or vice-versa. Auto-interpretability yields 684 684 automatically validated SAE features in Qwen3-TTS spanning shared voice profiles, speaking styles, and recording conditions beyond known concepts.
blocks.zh: 作为我们的主要模型,我们研究Quen3-TTS(Hu等人,2026年),并将探测和引导扩大到另外5个Fish,Higgs,和CosyVoice2模型,以测试跨建筑的通用化. 我们利用SAE、PCA、随机方向和未经训练的SAE, 将激活转换成语音级别特性。 我们发现模型编码投注,能量,噪音,口音,和情感,但只有一些概念从几个特征上可以预测. 五氯苯甲醚和随机方向是强有力的基线,而从对人类标注的概念的微小预测来看,SAE的平均绩效超过了五氯苯甲醚。 地物方向可以引导投球,能量,噪音,和光谱特性,其效果因模型和概念而异. 强烈的零星预测并不总是转化为方向或相反。 自动可解释性在Qune3-TTS中生成684 684个自动验证的SAE特性,跨越了共享语音配置,说话风格,记录条件超出了已知的概念.

blocks.en:
Future studies could use our probing setup to track representation changes during fine-tuning. Discovered features could also guide investigations of unwanted transfer of background music or reverberation from reference speech.
Steering demos and discovered features are at https://anonymous.4open.science/w/tts_interp_demo/ . Code will be released at https://github.com/ajd12342/voice-cloning-interp .

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: • We introduce a feature-based interpretability framework for zero-shot voice-cloning TTS, comparing SAE, PCA, and random features through sparse probing and generation-time steering. We probe 55 55 extractor-derived and 21 21 human-labelled concepts and steer all extractor concepts. • We test the generalizability of our pipeline and findings across architectures, extending probing and steering from our detailed Qwen3-TTS study to 5 5 additional Fish, Higgs, and CosyVoice2 models. • We develop a quantitative auto-interpretability pipeline that tests labeled features for coherence, predictive fit, and stability, discovering 684 684 automatically validated SAE features in Qwen3-TTS spanning voice profiles, speaking styles, and recording conditions.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的贡献是: 我们为零镜头语音克隆TTS引入基于特征的可解释性框架,通过稀疏的探测和生成时间引导来比较SAE,PCA和随机特性. 我们探索了55个55个提取物和21个人类标注的概念,并指导所有提取物概念。 我们测试我们整个建筑的管道和结果的通用性,从我们详细的Quen3-TTS研究扩大到另外5个鱼、希格斯和CosyVoice2模型。 我们开发了一个定量的自动解释管道,测试标注的特性,以达到一致性、预测性适合性和稳定性,发现684 684个自动验证的SAE特性在Qune3-TTS中跨越语音剖面,说话风格和记录条件.

blocks.en: 2.1 Models and Activation Extraction
blocks.zh: 2.1 模型和激活

blocks.en: We restrict analysis to the autoregressive backbone residual stream in each model. During inference, we prefill each model with the reference text, target text and reference speech, autoregressively generate target speech, and finally use their respective decoders to decode the generated tokens into a waveform akin to other autoregressive TTS models ( Du et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们把分析局限于每个模型中的自旋性骨干残留流. 在推论中,我们预填每个模型的参考文本,目标文本和参考语句,自动生成目标语句,最后使用各自的解码器将生成的代币解码为类似于其他自动回归TTS模型的波形(Du等人,2024年;Chen等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Qwen3-TTS We select Qwen3-TTS for its architectural compatibility with text SAEs ( Gao et al., 2025 ) , competitive TTS performance ( Hu et al., 2026 ) , and lack of explicit style supervision. We use the 0.6 0.6 B variant, which represents speech with 16 16 codebooks at 12 12 Hz. Its 28 28 -layer backbone with hidden size d = 1024 d=1024 predicts the first-codebook token for each speech frame, and a 5 5 -layer multi-token prediction (MTP) module predicts the remaining 15 15 codebook tokens.
blocks.zh: Qwen3-TTS (中文(简体) ). 我们选择了 Qwen3-TTS 的建筑兼容性与文本 SAEs (Gao et al., 2025), 竞争性 TTS 性能(Hu et al., 2026), 以及缺乏明确的风格监督. 我们使用0.6 0.6 B变体,代表语音的有16个16个编码本,位于12 12 Hz. 它的28个28层主干,隐藏大小d = 1024 d = 1024 预言每个语音框的第一个编码本代号,一个5个5层的多键预测(MTP)模块预言剩下的15个15个编码本代号.

blocks.en: Other Models Fish S1-mini is a 0.5 0.5 B model with a 28 28 -layer backbone and hidden size d = 1024 d=1024 , while Fish S2 Pro has a 4 4 B backbone with 36 36 layers and d = 2560 d=2560 , followed by a 400 400 M fast transformer. Both use 10 10 codec streams, the autoregressive backbone predicts the first stream, and a fast transformer predicts the remaining 9 9 . Higgs TTS 2 has 28 28 backbone layers with d = 3072 d=3072 and 5.8 5.8 B parameters: 3.6 3.6 B in the language model and 2.2 2.2 B in audio-specific feed-forward layers. Higgs TTS 3 ( Boson AI, 2026 ) uses a 4 4 B backbone with 36 36 layers and d = 2560 d=2560 . A conditional flow model converts these into mel features, followed by a vocoder. The flow model also receives reference speech tokens and reference mel features.

We train with Adam, learning rate 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , and batches of 4096 4096 token activations. Full training settings and sweep results are in Appendices B and B.1 . We max-pool each feature over tokens to obtain utterance-level features, as in Aparin et al. (2026) .

blocks.en: 3 Probing and Steering Known Concepts
blocks.zh: 3 探测和指导已知概念

blocks.en: Figure 1 summarizes our evaluation of predefined acoustic and paralinguistic concepts, inspired by Wu et al. (2025) . We compare prediction from a few features with the full feature set using Karvonen et al. (2025) ’s sparse top- k k probing, then steer aligned features to test whether they causally affect generated speech without changing other concepts.
blocks.zh: 图1总结了我们对预定义的声学和准语言概念的评价,受吴等人(2025)的启发. 我们用Karvonen等人(2025年)的稀疏的顶端-k k 探测器将一些特征的预测和完整的特征集进行比较,然后引导对齐的特征测试它们是否因果地影响生成的语音而不改变其他概念.

blocks.en: 3.1 Known-Concept Labels
blocks.zh: 3.1 已知概念标签

blocks.en: Extractor Concepts We run extractors for pitch, energy, voicing, timing, noise, formants, emotion dimensions, and gender over the main corpus analysis split. We apply reliability filters, such as minimum voiced frames, so each concept is evaluated only when well-defined, and average frame-level outputs when needed. These extractors are also run on generated waveforms during steering.
blocks.zh: 解析器概念 我们运行的提取器 投球,能量,发声,计时,噪音, 造型,情感维度,和性别 与主体分析分开。 我们采用了可靠性过滤器,例如最小的表达式帧,所以每个概念只有在定义明确时才会得到评价,需要时才会得到平均帧级输出. 这些提取器也在转向时运行在生成的波形上.

blocks.en: Human-Labelled Concepts We use the ParaSpeechCaps tag concept set defined in Section 2.2 . Its annotations cover speaker and style concepts including vocal texture, clarity, loudness, emotion, and accent. These tags are used for sparse probing but not for steering because reliably assigning them to generated waveforms would require collecting human annotations.
blocks.zh: 人类概念 我们用ParaSpeech 区域中定义的标签概念集 2.2 国家 其说明涵盖扬声器和风格概念,包括声调纹理,清晰度,响亮度,情感,和重音. 这些标记用于稀疏的探测,但不用于方向盘,因为可靠地将其分配到生成的波形需要收集人类注释.

blocks.en: 3.2 Sparse Probing Setup
blocks.zh: 3.2 Sparse 测试设置

blocks.en: Binary Dataset Setup We convert extractor and human labels into binary concepts. Continuous-valued concepts such as pitch become low- and high-tail concepts; probabilistic concepts, such as emotion, stay only high-tail; and human-labelled tags become binary concepts with tagged utterances as positives. We split each dataset 70 70 %/ 10 10 %/ 20 20 % by speaker ID into disjoint train, val, and test splits for probing. This yields 55 55 extractor concepts and 21 21 final human-labelled concepts. More details in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 二进制数据集设置 我们把提取器和人类标签转换成二进制概念。 连续价值的概念,如投球成为低尾和高尾的概念;概率的概念,如情感,只停留高尾;人类标记的标记成为二进制的概念,用标记的语句作为阳性. 我们把每个数据集 70 70%/ 10 10%/ 20 20% 的扬声器 ID 分为脱节列车, val, 和测试分解 检测。 这产生了55个55个提炼概念和21个人类标记的最后概念。 详见附录C。

blocks.en: Feature Selection and Probe Training For every concept, feature set, and layer, we rank features by the absolute positive-negative mean difference on the train split. We then train an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -regularized logistic probe on the top k ∈ { 1 , 2 , 5 , 10 , all } k\in\{1,2,5,10,\mathrm{all}\} features, tune the decision threshold on val F1, and evaluate F1 on the test split. All models use the same splits for probe-training and held-out test sets. Comparisons across models use Qwen3-TTS layer 19 19 and the layers specified in Section 2.1 for the other models. Additional Qwen3-TTS details are in Appendix C.1 .
blocks.zh: 特征选择和勘探培训 对于每一个概念,特征集,和层,我们按照列车分割上的绝对正负平均差来排列特征. 然后在顶端训练一个l 2\ell\2} - 正规的后勤探测器 k\\ { 1, 2, 5, 10, 都} k\in\ 1, 2, 5, 10,\ mathrm{all\ 特性, 调和 Val F1 上的决定阈值, 在测试分时评价 F1 。 所有型号都使用相同的拆分来进行探测训练以及停产测试。 跨模型的比较使用Qwen3-TTS第19层,其他模型则使用第2.1节中规定的各层. 附录C.1载有另外的Qwen3-TTS细节。

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics We report normalized F1 to compare concepts with different positive rates. For a given concept, let F1 null \mathrm{F1}_{\mathrm{null}} be the F1 of an always-positive classifier on the test split and define normalized nF1 k = ( F1 k − F1 null ) / ( 1 − F1 null ) \mathrm{nF1}_{k}=(\mathrm{F1}_{k}-\mathrm{F1}_{\mathrm{null}})/(1-\mathrm{F1}_{\mathrm{null}}) .
blocks.zh: 评价计量 我们报告说,F1已规范化,以比较不同正率的概念。 对于给定的概念,让 F1 无效\ mathrm{ F1}\ mathrm{ null} 在测试拆分上成为始终积极的分类器的 F1 , 并定义正态的 nF1 k = (F1 k − F1 无效) / (1 − F1 无效)\ mathrm{ nF1}}\ mathrm{ f1}}\ mathrm{ null} / (1- mathrm{ f1}) 。 。 。

blocks.en: Recoverability is nF1 k = all \mathrm{nF1}_{k=\mathrm{all}} , measuring how well the full feature set recovers the concept. Sparse recoverability is nF1 k = 2 \mathrm{nF1}_{k=2} , measuring how well the concept can be recovered from only 2 2 features.

blocks.en: Extractor concepts are broadly recoverable, with duration, energy, pitch, spectral tilt, and gender among the strongest. Pitch, energy, and gender also have strong sparse recoverability, while speaking rate, accent, and many spectral properties are much better predicted using all features.
blocks.zh: 抽取器的概念大致可以回收,其持续时间、能量、投球、光谱倾斜以及性别在最强者之列。 皮奇,能量,和性别也有很强的稀疏的可回收性,而说话速度,口音,以及许多光谱特性都利用所有特征得到更好的预测.

blocks.en: Human-labelled concepts are less consistently recoverable; only accents and some styles are. Whispered has strong SAE sparse recoverability across all models. British accent is more sparsely recoverable from SAEs in Fish and CosyVoice2 than at Qwen3-TTS layer 19 19 , although Qwen3-TTS improves at layer 26 26 (Appendix E.3 ).
blocks.zh: 人类标注的概念不太一致可回收;只有口音和一些风格才是. Whispered拥有强大的SAE 稀疏的可回收性 在所有的模型。 英国口音在Fish和CosyVoice2中从SAE中比在Quen3-TTS第19层更难回收,虽然Quen3-TTS第26层(附录E.3)有所改进.

blocks.en: Comparing feature sets , we find that across models, PCA and random directions have higher extractor-concept recoverability than SAE, while SAE exceeds PCA in sparse recoverability of human-labelled concepts (Figure 3(b) ). SAE leads in sparse extractor-concept recoverability only in Qwen3-TTS. Results comparing various k k values are in Appendix E.2 .
blocks.zh: 比较各套特征,我们发现,跨模型、五氯苯甲醚和随机方向的提取器受体可回收性高于SAE,而在人类标签概念的稀疏可回收性方面,SAE则超过五氯苯甲醚(图3(b))。 SAE领先于稀疏的提取器-概念可回收性仅在Quen3-TTS中. 对比各种kk值的结果载于附录E.2。

blocks.en: Comparing models , we find broadly similar all-feature nF1 for extractor concepts in Qwen3-TTS, Fish, and Higgs. CosyVoice2 also has lower all-feature nF1, particularly for energy and spectral concepts, although duration and speaking rate remain well predicted.

blocks.en: Layerwise analysis plots for Qwen3-TTS are in Appendix E.3 . For SAE features, extractor concepts are already recoverable in early layers, but sparse recoverability is strongest later. Human-labelled concepts improve in both metrics from early to later layers.

blocks.en: 3.4 Steering Setup
blocks.zh: 3.4 指导设置

blocks.en: Steering asks whether features associated with known concepts can causally affect generation. We steer all 55 55 extractor concepts using their top- 2 2 SAE, PCA, or random features. Like prior text ( Subramani et al., 2022 ; Turner et al., 2024 ; Rimsky et al., 2024 ) and speech ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2025 ) steering, we intervene at inference rather than learning style conditioning through training ( Wang et al., 2018 ; Diwan et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 指导性地询问与已知概念相关的特征是否会因果地影响生成. 我们用它们的顶部 2 2 SAE, PCA, 或随机特性来引导所有55个提取器概念. 和先前的文字(Subramani等人,2022年;Turner等人,2024年;Rimsky等人,2024年)和语音(Wang等人,2026年;Xie等人,2025年)一样,我们通过培训来干预推论,而不是学习风格调节(Wang等人,2018年;Diwan等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Generation Setup Each example pairs source audio and transcript with a target transcript. After prefilling with the source, we add λ \lambda times a steering vector to one layer’s residual stream during generation ( Turner et al., 2024 ) . Uniform steering compounded over time in Qwen3-TTS, so we linearly decay the intervention to zero over the expected generation length (Appendix C.2 ). We generate unsteered and steered speech at λ = 1 \lambda=1 on the same 100 100 examples across models, using Qwen3-TTS layers 19 19 and 26 26 and the other models’ layers from Section 2.1 .
blocks.zh: 生成设置每个示例将源音频和记录誊本与目标记录誊本对齐. 在与源头进行预填后,我们将在生成过程中将\\ lambda乘数加入一层残余流(Turner等人,2024年)。 在Qune3-TTS中,统一方向盘随时间推移而复杂,因此,我们线性地将干预在预期的生成长度上变为零(附录C.2)。 我们利用第2.1节的Qune3-TTS第19和26层以及其他模型的图层,

blocks.en: Steering Vectors For SAE, PCA, and random directions, we sum the concept’s signed top- 2 2 unit directions, each scaled by its cached activation standard deviation. Prior work instead tunes steering strength ( Rimsky et al., 2024 ; Durmus et al., 2024 ; Chalnev et al., 2024 ) . A supervised DiffMean topline ( Marks and Tegmark, 2024 ) uses the positive-minus-negative mean activation, unit-normalized and scaled by the std along that direction (Appendix C.2 ).
blocks.zh: 对SAE、PCA和随机方向的矢量进行引导, 我们汇总了这个概念上签的 2 2 个单位方向, 每一个方向都以它缓存的激活标准偏差来缩放。 先前的工作转而调整方向强度(Rimsky等人,2024年;Durmus等人,2024年;Chalnev等人,2024年)。 受监督的DiffMean顶线(Marks and Tegmark, 2024)使用正负正负平均值激活,单位正常化,并按该方向由std缩放(Appendix C.2 ).

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics We compare extractor scores between steered and unsteered waveforms, normalizing paired changes by each concept’s analysis-split 95 95 th– 5 5 th percentile range. Measurements and changes are not clipped, so scores can exceed 1 1 .
blocks.zh: 评价计量 我们比较了导波和未导波的分数,按每个概念的分析-95 95 – 5 5 百分位范围将对数变化正常化。 测量和变化不剪切,因此得分可以超过11.

blocks.en: Target Change measures intended change ( Rimsky et al., 2024 ; Durmus et al., 2024 ) as the median signed normalized change across utterances, positive in the requested direction.
blocks.zh: 目标改变措施 打算改变(Rimsky等人,2024年;Durmus等人,2024年),因为所签名的中位数在各种言语中实现了正常变化,在所要求的方向是积极的。

blocks.en: Off-target change measures side effects ( Durmus et al., 2024 ; Chalnev et al., 2024 ) on protected concepts : non-target concepts we aim to preserve, excluding those strongly correlated with the target on the analysis split. We take the median absolute normalized change across utterances for each protected concept, then the median across concepts (Appendix C.2 ).
blocks.zh: 非目标变化措施副作用 (Durmus等人,2024年;Chalnev等人,2024年)关于受保护的概念: 我们的目标是保留非目标概念,不包括那些与分析目标密切相关的概念。 我们把每个受保护概念的中位数绝对常态变化,然后是概念的中位数(附录C.2)。

blocks.en: For Quality , we report paired mean Δ \Delta WER (percentage points) using Whisper large-v3 ( Radford et al., 2023 ) and Δ \Delta UTMOS using UTMOS ( Saeki et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 关于质量,我们报告用Whisper大V3(Radford等人,2023年)和使用UTMOS(Saeki等人,2022年)的\Delta UTMOS(Saeki等人,2022年)对平均数值(百分比)进行配对。

blocks.en: Comparing feature sets , we find that SAE, PCA, and DiffMean increase Target Change with strength. Stronger steering also increases off-target change and sometimes reduces quality (Figure 6 ). Random directions have near-zero Target Change despite competitive probing performance. In Qwen3-TTS and Fish, supervised DiffMean has the lowest off-target change, followed by SAE and PCA. SAE has smaller Δ \Delta WER and Δ \Delta UTMOS costs than PCA, while DiffMean has smaller UTMOS drops (Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们发现SAE、PCA和DiffMean 都用力量增加目标改变。 更强的引导也增加了非目标变化,有时会降低质量(图6)。 随机方向有近零目标变化,尽管有竞争性的测试性能. 在Qune3-TTS和Fish中,受监督的DiffMean的离目标变化最小,其次是SAE和PCA. SAE拥有比PCA更小的\Delta WER和\Delta UTMOS成本,而DiffMean拥有更小的UTMOS滴(图4).

blocks.en: Figure 5: Top 10 10 Qwen3-TTS layer- 19 19 concepts by SAE median Target Change, comparing all four methods at λ = 1 \lambda=1 on 100 100 examples. Takeaway : SAE target changes are largest for energy, pitch, spectral and voice-quality properties. Quality losses partly reflect deliberately reducing SNR or pushing RMS toward either extreme.
blocks.zh: 图5:前10 Qwen3-TTS层 - 19 19个概念由SAE中位目标变化,在100个实例上比较所有四个方法 QQ=1\lambda=1. Takeaway : SAE目标变化最大的是能量,投球,光谱和语音质量属性. 质量损失部分反映了故意减少SNR或将RMS推向任意一种极端。

blocks.en: Comparing concepts , we find that steering works well for RMS, low-SNR, pitch, and spectral and voice-quality properties (Figure 5 ). Low-SNR and RMS quality costs are partly expected: low-SNR steering should add noise, while RMS interventions deliberately make speech much louder or quieter. Spectral and voice-quality effects also appear in Fish. Most SAE changes in accent and emotion scores are small, while timing results are mixed.
blocks.zh: 在比较概念时,我们发现,引导对RMS、低SNR、投影以及光谱和语音质量特性都行之有效(图5)。 低SNR和RMS的质量成本是部分预期的:低SNR方向应增加噪音,而RMS的干预则故意使言论更响亮或更安静. 光谱效应和语音质量效应也在Fish中出现. 大部分SAE的口音和情感分数变化很小,而计时结果好坏参半.

blocks.en: Comparing models , we find larger mean Target Change from SAE, PCA, and DiffMean in Qwen3-TTS and Fish than in Higgs TTS 2 and CosyVoice2 (Figure 4 ). At the studied layers, SAE pitch steering is strong in Qwen3-TTS and Fish but weak in Higgs TTS 2, where PCA and DiffMean are more effective. SAE instead steers RMS and formants in Higgs TTS 2. In Higgs TTS 3, SAE severely degrades speech (Figure 9 ).
blocks.zh: 比起Higgs TTS 2和CosyVoice2(图4), 在研究层中,SAE的投球方向盘在Qune3-TTS和Fish中很强,但在Higgs TTS 2中则很弱,其中PCA和DiffMean效果更高. SAE 转而在 Higgs TTS 中引导 RMS 和 成型剂 2. 国家 在Higgs TTS 3中,SAE严重降解语音(图9).

blocks.en: Figure 6: Qwen3-TTS strength sweeps, averaged across a fixed set of 9 9 probing-selected targets on the same 100 100 utterances (Appendix C.2 ). Layers 19 19 / 26 26 use solid/dotted lines. Takeaway : SAE, PCA, and DiffMean increase target change with strength while random directions remain ineffective. SAE has lower off-target change than PCA but pays a WER/UTMOS cost.
blocks.zh: 图6: Qune3-TTS强度扫射,平均在同一个100话(Appendix C.2.)上的9个9个探测选定目标固定组合. 层19 19 / 26 26使用固态/虚态线条. Takeaway :SAE,PCA,和DiffMean增加目标变化,同时随机方向仍然无效. SAE的离目标变化低于PCA,但支付WER/UTMOS成本.

blocks.en: Uniform steering in Qwen3-TTS can compound over time (e.g. progressively increasing pitch), motivating our decay schedule (Section 3.4 ). This anecdote suggests that the model may encode pitch locally rather than at the utterance-level, opening the possibility of temporally varying controls.
blocks.zh: Qune3-TTS中的统一转向可以随着时间的推移复合(例如,逐渐增加投球),激发我们的衰变时间表(第3.4节)。 这一传闻表明,该模型可能在当地而不是在言论层面编码投球,从而开启了暂时性不同控制的可能性。

blocks.en: Comparing probing and steering , we find that strong probing does not always translate to steering. SAE sparse recoverability correlates weakly with Target Change across concepts in Qwen3-TTS, and barely at all in Fish (Appendix C.2 ). In Qwen3-TTS, top- 2 2 SAE steering barely changes duration at layer 19 19 despite strong sparse recoverability, but increases spectral centroid at layer 26 26 despite weak sparse recoverability.
blocks.zh: 我们发现强力探测并非总能变成方向。 SAE稀疏的可回收性与Qune3-TTS概念中的目标变化关系不大,在Fish(附录C.2)中则几乎完全没有联系。 在 Qune3-TTS 中,上 2 2 SAE 方向盘在 19 层几乎没有改变持续时间,尽管极少数的可回收性,但在26 层增加光谱百分数,尽管微弱的可回收性.

blocks.en: 4 Discovering Novel Concepts
blocks.zh: 4 发现小说概念

blocks.en: Known-concept evaluations test whether model features can capture predefined concepts. To study model behavior beyond those, we auto-interpret ( Bills et al., 2023 ) features leveraging an audio LLM to label features using highly activating audio examples, as depicted in Figure 1 . Due to API costs, we restrict this analysis to Qwen3-TTS. AudioSAE ( Aparin et al., 2026 ) uses natural-language labels qualitatively. We instead evaluate labeled features using three quantitative metrics: Coherence, Label Fit, and Label Stability.
blocks.zh: 已知概念评价测试模型特征是否能够捕捉到预先定义的概念. 为了研究这些之外的模型行为,我们自动解释(Bills et al., 2023年)的功能是利用音频LLM, 使用高度激活的音频实例来标记特性, 如图1所示。 由于API的成本,我们仅限于Quen3-TTS分析. AudioSAE(Aparin等人,2026年)在质量上使用自然语言标签. 相反,我们使用三个量化尺度来评价标签特征: 一致性、贴标签和标签稳定性。

blocks.en: 4.1 Auto-Interpretability Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 自动解释设置

blocks.en: Features and Utterances We randomly sample 500 500 features per set at Qwen3-TTS layer 19 19 . For SAE features, we z-score nonzero activations, selecting utterances with z > 2 z>2 as activating and activation 0 0 as contrasts. For PCA and random directions, we z-score over all utterances and use z > 2 z>2 as activating and z ≤ 0 z\leq 0 as contrasts.
blocks.zh: 特征和功能 我们随机抽取500个特征 每套在 Qune3 -TTS 层 19 19。 对于SAE特性,我们Z-分数的非零激活,选择使用z > 2 z>2的语句作为激活和激活0作为对比. 对于PCA和随机方向,我们在所有的语句上以z计分,并使用z > 2 z>2作为激活,z=0 z\leq 0作为对比.

blocks.en: Label Generation For each feature, we randomly sample 5 5 activating and 5 5 contrast utterances and ask Gemini 3.5 3.5 Flash for the acoustic property that best separates them (Appendix D ). An example of a generated label is ‘Whispered or highly breathy, hushed speech’ .
blocks.zh: 标签生成 对于每个特性,我们随机抽取5个5个激活和5个5个对比语,并询问双子座3.5 3.5 Flash的音响属性最能将它们分开(附录D ). 一个生成的标签的例子就是“低声或极低气息、阴沉的言论”。

blocks.en: Label Evaluation Our metrics assess the coherence of activating utterances, the predictive fit of labels on held-out audio, and their stability across reruns and resampling. Since Gemini is used both to generate and evaluate labels, these automated metrics alone do not establish independent ground-truth validation, but jointly test Gemini’s labeling abilities and feature-label alignment. They compare how consistently features can be described and predicted under a fixed audio LLM and protocol. We additionally measure human Label Fit on a subset of SAE features as an independent check (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 标签评价 我们的衡量标准评估了激活语句的一致性、被搁置音频上的标签的预测性合合身性,以及它们跨重播和重印的稳定性。 由于双子座既用于生成和评审标签,这些自动化的度量衡单靠它并不能建立独立的地面真实性验证,而是联合测试双子座的标签能力和特征标签的校正. 它们比较了在固定的音频LLM和协议下如何连贯地描述和预测特征. 此外,我们还用SAE特征的子集衡量人类标签,作为独立的检查(第4.2节)。

blocks.en: Coherence is the mean accuracy over 5 5 trials where Gemini identifies the outlier among 10 10 activating and 1 1 contrast utterance, following intruder-style evaluation ( Paulo and Belrose, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 在5个试验中, 双子座辨别出10个激活和1个反差,

blocks.en: Label Fit is the accuracy when Gemini classifies held-out utterances ( 10 10 activating, 10 10 contrast) as matching the label or not, following detection-based scoring ( Paulo et al., 2025 ; Bills et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: Fit标签是双子座根据检测得分(Paulo等人,2025年;Bills等人,2023年)将持有的言论(10 10个激活,10个对比)归类为是否匹配标签时的准确性。

blocks.en: Label Stability compares labels regenerated from the original utterances and a disjoint set of 5 5 activating and 5 5 contrast utterances against the main label. Gemini scores each comparison as 1.0 1.0 for same, 0.5 0.5 for overlapping, and 0 0 for different/unclear; we average the two scores.
blocks.zh: 标签稳定性比较了从原始语句中重现的标签,以及5个5个激活语句和5个5个对比语句与主标签的脱节语句. 双子座的分数每次比较,相同者为1.01.0,重叠者为0.50.5,不同/不清晰者为0;我们平均分数为2。

blocks.en: Automatically validated features have Coherence ≥ 3 / 5 \geq 3/5 , Label Fit ≥ 0.75 \geq 0.75 , and Label Stability ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 .
blocks.zh: 自动验证的特性具有一致性 3 / 5\ geq 3/5, 标签适合 0.75\ geq 0.75, 标签稳定性 0.5\ geq 0.5。

blocks.en: Controls Random guessing gives 1 / 11 \nicefrac{{1}}{{11}} Coherence, 0.5 0.5 Label Fit, and 0.375 0.375 Stability under uniform verdicts. Shuffled labels tests Label Fit with another feature’s label; random audio tests Coherence and Label Fit with randomly sampled utterances.
blocks.zh: 随机猜测给出 1 / 11\nicefrac \% 1\% 1\% 11\% 一致性、0.5 0.5标签和0.375 0.375 在统一判决下保持稳定。 Shuffled的标签用另一个特性的标签进行测试; 随机的音频测试 一致性和标签用随机抽样的言论进行测试。

blocks.en: 4.2 Auto-Interpretability Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 自动解释 结果

blocks.en: Table 1: Auto-interpretability of 500 500 Qwen3-TTS layer- 19 19 features per set ( 95 % 95\% bootstrap intervals). Takeaway : SAE scores highest on all three metrics and yields the most validated features.
blocks.zh: 表1:500 Quen3-TTS层的自动可解释性——每套19个特性(95% 95%的靴子间隔). Takeaway : SAE在所有三个度量标准上得分最高,产生最有效的特性.

blocks.en: Comparing feature sets , we find that SAE scores highest on all three metrics and yields the most validated features ( 92 92 , versus 17 17 random and 1 1 PCA; Table 1 ). Random directions approach SAE on Label Fit but trail on Coherence and Stability, suggesting that Label Fit alone is insufficient for interpretability. PCA is near chance on Coherence and Label Fit. Shuffled-label and random-audio controls score near chance, indicating that the results depend on feature-matched labels and audio.
blocks.zh: 比较功能集,我们发现SAE在所有三个度量标准上得分最高,并产生最有效的特征(92 92,对17 17随机和1 PCA;表1)。 随机方向接近适合标签的SAE,但跟踪一致性和稳定性,说明仅适合标签不足以解释。 常设仲裁院几乎有机会取得一致性和标签。 shuffled-label和随机音频控制得分接近偶然,表明结果取决于特征匹配的标签和音频.

blocks.en: Human evaluation We measure human Label Fit on 50 50 validated and 50 50 nonvalidated SAE features randomly sampled from the original 500 500 layer- 19 19 SAE features. For each feature, Amazon Mechanical Turk annotators judge whether its label matches each of 5 5 activating and 5 5 contrast utterances, with 2 2 – 3 3 ratings per clip. Validated features achieve higher human Label Fit ( 64.4 % 64.4\% vs. 51.0 % 51.0\% , averaged across features), with nonvalidated features near the 50 % 50\% chance baseline. This suggests that validation selects labels that better distinguish activating from contrast utterances.
blocks.zh: 人类评价 我们用50个经验证的和50个未经验证的SAE特征来测量人类标签。 Amazon Mechanical Turk的注解师判断, 经验证的特征可以实现更高的人类标签适配(64.4%对51.0%对51.0%对51),未经验证的特征接近50%的50%机会基线。 这表明验证选择的标签可以更好地区分激活语与对比语.

blocks.en: Discovered concepts We manually grouped the 92 92 validated SAE features by their primary label. Of these, 72 72 are speaker cluster features describing timbre and accent: 37 37 male narration and synthetic-sounding reading voices, 14 14 female voices spanning British narration, conversation and breathy storytelling, and 21 21 other profiles including sports and podcast voices, gravelly male voices, and accented instruction. The remaining 20 20 cover accent ( 5 5 ), laughter ( 4 4 ), recording conditions ( 3 3 ), whispering and synthetic-sounding speech ( 2 2 each), plus vocal fry, disfluencies, sports commentary, and expressive podcast delivery.
blocks.zh: 发现的概念 我们用手动将92个经验证的SAE特性按其主要标签分类。 其中72个是演讲者群集的特征,描述潮湿和口音:37个男性叙事和合成声读音,14个女性语音,涵盖英国叙事,交谈和呼吸故事,21个其他简介,包括体育和播客声音,猛烈的男性声音,以及重音教学. 其余20个封面口音(5个5个),笑声(4个4个4个),录音条件(3个3个),低声和合成语音(每个2个2个),加上声煎,不流畅,体育评论,以及表达播客的发送.

blocks.en: Since SAEs performed best, we extend discovery to the remaining eligible layer- 19 19 features, yielding 592 592 additional validated SAE features. These distinguish finer narration styles (deep audiobook voices, British academic reading, dramatic storytelling, robotic delivery), conversational profiles (raspy sports commentary, youthful gaming voices, gravelly lecturing), and laughter (during speech, amused delivery, background laughter). Other labels describe shouting, preaching, slow pacing, background music, reverberation, coughs, throat clearing, and backchannels.
blocks.zh: 由于SAEs的表现最好,我们把发现扩展到其余的合格层——19个特征,产生了592 592个额外的经验证的SAE特征. 这些较细微的叙事风格(深音书语音,英国学术阅读,戏剧故事解说,机器人投递),对话简介(粗略的体育评论,青春的游戏声音,石刻的讲解),以及笑声(在演讲期间,有趣的投递,背景笑声). 其他标签描述喊叫,传教,慢步,背景音乐,反响,咳嗽,清喉,以及后通道.

blocks.en: Speaker diversity analysis Auto-interpretability found many speaker cluster features, motivating further analysis. For each SAE feature, we extract speaker embeddings ( Ravanelli et al., 2021 ) and apply cosine agglomerative clustering (Appendix D ). Speaker clusters differ from speaker IDs: validated SAE features span a median of 26 26 path-derived IDs across stored activating examples. Features with at most 5 5 embedding clusters account for 19.5 % 19.5\% of eligible SAE features but 63.7 % 63.7\% of the 684 684 validated features. This enrichment may reflect the substantial timbre capacity needed for voice-cloning, but also the auto-interpretability pipeline: timbre may be easier for the judge to perceive, describe, and verify, making such features more likely to pass all three checks.
blocks.zh: 议长多样性分析 自动可解释性发现许多扬声器集群特征,促使进一步分析. 对于每个 SAE 特性,我们提取扬声器嵌入(Ravanelli等人,2021年),并应用余弦凝聚(附录D). 扬声器集群与扬声器ID不同:经验证的SAE特性跨中位数26个路径衍生的ID,跨越存储的激活实例. 最多5个嵌入式集群的特征占合格SAE特征的19.5%,但684 684个有效特征中的63.7%。 这种浓缩可能反映了语音克隆所需的巨大凹陷能力,但也反映了自动可解释性管道:凹凸可能更便于法官察觉、描述和核实,使这些特征更有可能通过所有三项检查。

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: SAEs for mechanistic interpretability SAEs learn overcomplete sparse dictionaries whose latents are often more interpretable than neurons ( Huben et al., 2024 ; Bricken et al., 2023 ) . We follow recent work in evaluating their usefulness through sparse prediction, causal interventions, and steering ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Karvonen et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 用于机械解释的SAE学习过量的零星词典,其潜伏性往往比神经元更易解释(Huben等人,2024年;Bricken等人,2023年)。 我们关注最近通过少许预测、因果干预和引导评估其效用的工作(Gao等人,2025年;Karvonen等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Interpreting speech and audio encoders SAEs, PCA, and related decompositions have been applied to speech/audio encoders ( Chen et al., 2022 ; Hsu et al., 2021 ; Défossez et al., 2023 ) , revealing features aligned with pitch, emotion, accent, and loudness ( Aparin et al., 2026 ; Mariotte et al., 2025 ; Paek et al., 2025 ; van Rensburg et al., 2026 ) . Some features can steer vocoders ( Paek et al., 2025 ; van Rensburg et al., 2026 ) or reduce transcription errors ( Aparin et al., 2026 ) . Unlike this encoder-focused work, we study generative voice-cloning TTS models. Most of this work evaluates prespecified concepts. AudioSAE ( Aparin et al., 2026 ) uses natural-language labels for qualitative inspection; we instead evaluate labels quantitatively.
blocks.zh: 语音和音频编码器SAEs,PCA,以及相关的解码器被应用于语音/音频编码器(Chen等人,2022年;Hsu等人,2021年;Défossez等人,2023年),揭示了与投球,情感,口音和响度一致的特征(Aparin等人,2026年;Maritte等人,2025年;Paek等人,2025年;van Rensburg等人,2026年). 一些特性可以引导vocoders(Paek等人,2025年;van Rensburg等人,2026年)或减少抄录错误(Aparin等人,2026年). 与这种以编码器为重点的工作不同,我们研究基因化的语音克隆TTS模型. 这项工作大部分评价预先确定的概念。 AudioSAE(Aparin等人,2026年)使用自然语言的标签进行质量检查;相反,我们对标签进行定量评估。

blocks.en: TTS interpretability Prior TTS work finds PCA components for gender and intensity in Grad-TTS ( Varshavsky-Hassid et al., 2024 ) and probes encoder-decoder TTS models for syllabic and phonemic features ( Lenglet et al., 2026 ) . These studies focus on known concepts in non-voice-cloning models. We instead compare multiple feature sets through probing and steering of known concepts across 6 6 zero-shot voice-cloning TTS models, and discover novel concepts in Qwen3-TTS. While contemporaneous work on CosyVoice3 ( Koriagin et al., 2026 ) demonstrates steering with 3 3 selected SAE features, we systematically compare SAE and PCA steering across all 55 55 extractor targets, including off-target changes and speech quality. Our probing and steering comparisons span 6 6 TTS models, testing generalization across architectures.
blocks.zh: TTS 解释性 先前的TTS工作在Grad-TTS(Varshavsky-Hassid等人,2024年)中发现了PCA的性别和强度成分,以及用于音节和语音特征的探测器编码器-解码器TTS模型(Lenglet等人,2026年)。 这些研究侧重于非语音克隆模型中的已知概念. 相反,我们通过在6个零镜头语音克隆TTS模型中探测和引导已知概念,比较多个功能集,并在Qune3-TTS中发现新概念. 同时期关于CosyVoice3(Koriagin等人,2026年)的工作显示方向有3个选定的SAE特性,但我们系统比较了SAE和PCA在所有55个提取目标中的方向,包括非目标变化和语音质量。 我们的测试和引导比较跨越6个TTS模型,测试跨架构的通用性.

blocks.en: Controllable TTS Most controllable TTS trains models on labels, style instructions, or reference audio ( Guo et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Diwan et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . CoCoEmo and EmoSteer-TTS ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2025 ) use activation steering, but only along supervised emotion directions. Related emotion-sensitive neuron studies ( Zhao et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2026b ) also target predefined emotions in audio understanding and generation. Our steering experiments instead ask whether features from unsupervised dictionaries can serve directly as training-free controls for diverse acoustic concepts across frozen voice-cloning models.
blocks.zh: 可控 TTS 数字 大部分可控TTS列车车型在标签,样式指示,或参考音频上(郭等,2023;杨等,2024;刘等,2023;迪旺等,2025;杜等,2024;陈等,2026). CoCoEmo和EmoSteer-TTS(Wang等人,2026年;Xie等人,2025年)使用激活方向,但仅沿受监督的情感方向运行. 相关的情感敏感神经元研究(赵等人,2026a); Zhao et al., 2026b )在音频理解和生成中也针对预定义的情绪. 我们的引导实验则询问,来自无监督词典的特征是否能够直接成为对不同声学概念的无培训控制,跨越冷冻语音克隆模型。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduce a feature-based interpretability framework for voice-cloning TTS, combining probing and steering across 6 6 models with novel-concept discovery in Qwen3-TTS. Many acoustic and paralinguistic concepts are recoverable, but only some are strongly predicted from a few features. Steering effects vary by model and concept, and strong sparse prediction does not always translate to effective steering. PCA and random directions are strong probing baselines, while SAEs are useful for sparse prediction of human-labelled concepts and novel-concept discovery. Auto-interpretability identifies 684 684 automatically validated SAE features spanning speaker clusters, speaking style, and recording conditions in Qwen3-TTS. Future work should extend analysis to multilingual speech, study how features vary temporally, and explore composition of controls.
blocks.zh: 我们为语音克隆TTS引入了基于特性的可解释性框架,将探测和引导6个模型与Qune3-TTS中的新概念发现结合起来. 许多声学和准语言学概念是可以恢复的,但只有一些概念是从少数特征中强烈预测出来的. 指导效应因模型和概念而异,强弱的预测并不总是转化为有效的指导. 五氯苯甲醚和随机方向是强有力的探测基线,而SAEs对于人类标签概念和新概念发现的少量预测是有用的。 自动可解释性识别684 684个自动验证的SAE特性,跨越扬声器集群,说话风格,以及Qune3-TTS的录制条件. 今后的工作应当将分析扩大到多语种语音,研究特征在时间上的差异,并探索控制的组成。

blocks.en: ⬇ I ’ m studying learned features inside a speech synthesis model . I ’ ve attached two groups of short speech clips for a given feature . The clips are attached inline in this message . Each audio attachment is immediately preceded by a text label . Treat these labels as the source of truth : labels ACTIVATING_1 , ACTIVATING_2 , ... are Group A , and labels CONTRAST_1 , CONTRAST_2 , ... are Group B . GROUP A ( labels ACTIVATING_ *): These clips all strongly activate a specific internal feature of the model . GROUP B ( labels CONTRAST_ *): These are random clips that do NOT activate this feature . Your task : Listen carefully to both groups and identify what acoustic , vocal , or recording property consistently distinguishes Group A from Group B . First , listen for the most salient pattern without assuming it belongs to any predefined category . Learned model features can correspond to subtle , unusual , or cross - cutting properties . After forming your initial hypothesis , use the following list only as a checklist of possibilities you may have missed , not as a constraint on the answer : - Voice quality ( breathy , creaky , nasal , hoarse , resonant , thin , etc .) - Recording conditions ( reverb , background noise type , microphone quality , room size , phone vs studio ) - Prosody ( monotone vs expressive , rising / falling intonation patterns , rhythm ) - Speaking style ( read speech vs conversational , formal vs casual , acted vs natural ) - Tempo and pacing ( fast , slow , many pauses , rushed ) - Pitch register ( not just high / low , but placement - head voice , chest voice ) - Energy dynamics ( consistently loud , quiet , dynamic range , fading ) - Emotional tone ( but be specific - not just " happy " but " politely enthusiastic " or " suppressed frustration ") - Articulatory features ( mumbling , crisp enunciation , specific vowel qualities , accent features ) - Any other pattern you notice , even if subtle , weird , mixed , or hard to name Be specific and concrete . Don ’ t say " Group A sounds different " - say exactly how . If you notice multiple distinguishing properties , list them in order of how consistent they are across all Group A clips . If you ’ re uncertain , say so and give your best guess with a confidence level . Prefer the pattern that best separates Group A from Group B , even if it does not fit cleanly into any category above . It is acceptable for the best explanation to combine multiple cues , such as " female speaker with close - mic studio audio " or " fast conversational delivery with clipped endings ." Important : this is a multimodal audio request . Do not answer as if you only have text labels . If your first instinct is to say you cannot access or play the audio , double - check the attached inline audio parts and use them . If the provider truly fails to expose the audio to you , still return the JSON schema below with confidence " low ", explain the access problem in notes_for_human_reviewer , and do not invent acoustic observations . Return only one valid JSON object . Do not wrap it in markdown . Use exactly these keys : - primary_pattern : one - line description - confidence : one of " high ", " medium ", or " low " - details : 2-3 sentences elaborating the pattern - secondary_patterns : list of additional distinguishing features , if present - counter_examples : list noting any Group A clips that don ’ t fit the pattern , or Group B clips that do - distinguishing_cues : list of short concrete acoustic / vocal / recording cues - label_short : concise lowercase dashboard - friendly label - is_likely_speaker_identity : boolean - notes_for_human_reviewer : string
